items.title: Show HN: I mapped every US golf course
items.titleZh: Show HN：我绘制了美国每个高尔夫球场的地图
items.summary:
I got tired of Googling basic course info, so I made a free directory of every US course Google filters for golf course results are terrible so I built a better way to browse courses using OSM as the backbone.... https://golfcoursebrowser.com/ It's a work in progress and mostly US for now, but I want to expand to the rest of North America, the EU, and the rest of the world ASAP. It's free, no ads, no login, no bs. If you spot anything wrong (bad info, a missing course, wrong scorecard), you can flag it right on the course page. I actually read those and fix them. Still a lot of missing info, but I'm filling out more and more each day. The goal is the most complete, and current golf course directory in the world, verified and maintained by actual golfers. I think is attainable in the next few months.
The base layer is OpenStreetMap, cross-checked against course websites and enriched with scorecards, USGA rating/slope, and public/private status. User corrections from golfers who know their home course have beaten every commercial data source we check against.

 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49054010

 Points: 155

 # Comments: 94
items.summaryZh:
我厌倦了在谷歌上搜索基本的球场信息，所以我为每个美国球场制作了一个免费目录。谷歌对高尔夫球场的过滤结果很糟糕，所以我建立了一种更好的方式来使用 OSM 作为骨干浏览球场...... https://golfcoursebrowser.com/ 这是一项正在进行的工作，目前主要是美国，但我想尽快扩展到北美其他地区、欧盟和世界其他地区。它是免费的，没有广告，无需登录，没有废话。如果您发现任何错误（错误信息、缺少课程、记分卡错误），您可以在课程页面上将其标记出来。我实际上阅读了这些内容并修复了它们。仍然有很多缺失的信息，但我每天都会填写越来越多的信息。目标是世界上最完整、最新的高尔夫球场目录，由实际高尔夫球手验证和维护。我认为在接下来的几个月内是可以实现的。
基础层是 OpenStreetMap，与球场网站进行交叉检查，并通过记分卡、USGA 评级/坡度以及公共/私人状态进行丰富。来自了解自己主场的高尔夫球手的用户更正击败了我们检查的所有商业数据源。
